    Small PlatesIvana's chessboard blini with smoked salmonHow Ivana keeps warm in Russia. Buckwheat blini, salmon, sour cream, dill.How to make it100g buckwheat flour50g plain flour1 tsp baking powder1 egg200ml milk30g butter, melted200g sliced smoked salmon150g sour cream1 lemon1/2 cup dill sprigsWhisk the flours, baking powder and a pinch of salt with the egg, milk and half the butter into a thick batter.Brush a frying pan with butter and drop in tablespoons of batter; cook until bubbles show, flip and cook another minute.Season the sour cream with lemon zest and a squeeze of juice.Top half the blini with salmon and half with just sour cream and dill, and set them out in a chequerboard.Mini-Me prawn cocktailsDr. Evil's clone, one-eighth the size. Prawns, iceberg and Marie Rose in tiny glasses.How to make it400g cooked king prawns, peeled1/4 iceberg lettuce, finely shredded125g whole-egg mayonnaise2 tbsp tomato sauce1 tsp Tabasco1 lemon1/2 tsp sweet paprika1 avocado, dicedMix the mayonnaise, tomato sauce, Tabasco and a squeeze of lemon into a Marie Rose sauce.Spoon lettuce and a little avocado into 8 small glasses.Pile on the prawns, hang one over each rim and spoon over the sauce.Dust with paprika and serve with lemon wedges.Fat Bastard's bedside fried chickenWould you like some chicken? I've got more. Buttermilk drumsticks, hot honey, pickles.How to make it8 chicken drumsticks500ml buttermilk200g plain flour2 tsp smoked paprika1 tsp garlic powder1 L vegetable oil, for frying4 tbsp honey1 tsp chilli flakes1 cup dill picklesSoak the drumsticks in the buttermilk with a big pinch of salt for at least 30 minutes, or overnight.Mix the flour, paprika, garlic powder and salt, then roll the drumsticks in it, pressing to coat.Fry in oil at 160°C, in batches, turning, until deep gold and cooked through.Warm the honey with the chilli, drizzle over and serve with pickles.SupperGet in my belly sticky baby back ribsFat Bastard to Mini-Me: get in my belly. Slow-baked pork ribs, smoky glaze, slaw.How to make it2kg pork baby back ribs, in racks2 tbsp brown sugar2 tsp smoked paprika1 tsp garlic powder250ml smoky barbecue sauce2 tbsp apple cider vinegar2 tbsp honey1/4 red cabbage, finely shredded2 carrots, grated4 tbsp whole-egg mayonnaiseRub the racks all over with the sugar, paprika, garlic powder and 2 tsp salt.Wrap each rack tightly in foil and bake at 150°C until the meat pulls back from the bones.Simmer the barbecue sauce, half the vinegar and the honey until glossy.Unwrap, brush with glaze and grill under high heat, brushing twice more, until sticky and charred.Toss the cabbage and carrot with the mayo and remaining vinegar, and serve with the ribs.The Alan Parsons Project steak DianeDr. Evil puts a giant laser on the moon. Sirloin flamed with brandy, creamy pan sauce.How to make it4 x 220g sirloin steaks2 tbsp olive oil40g butter2 French shallots, finely chopped2 garlic cloves, crushed60ml brandy1 tbsp Dijon mustard1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce200ml thickened cream2 tbsp chopped parsley600g thin-cut chipsBake the chips in a hot oven until crisp.Season the steaks and sear in the oil over high heat, 3 minutes a side for medium rare, then rest.Melt the butter and soften the shallots and garlic.Pour in the brandy, carefully set it alight and let the flames die down.Stir in the mustard, Worcestershire, cream and resting juices and bubble until glossy.Spoon the sauce over the steaks, scatter with parsley and serve with the chips.After the ShowBelgian Dip waffles with coffee creamDr. Evil's milk mustache, the Belgian Dip. Liege waffles to dunk in sweet coffee cream.How to make it250g plain flour7g sachet dried yeast120ml warm milk2 eggs150g soft butter100g pearl sugar or crushed sugar cubes300ml thickened cream2 tbsp icing sugar2 tsp instant coffeeMix the flour, yeast, milk and eggs into a dough, then knead in the butter until smooth.Cover and leave in a warm spot until puffy.Knead in the pearl sugar and cut into 8 balls.Cook in a hot waffle iron until deep gold and caramelised.Whip the cream with the icing sugar and coffee dissolved in a little hot water, and serve for dunking.From the BarAustin's mojoFat Bastard pinched Austin's mojo. White rum, lime, mint and soda, in a tall glass.How to make it240ml white rum4 limes1 cup mint leaves3 tbsp caster sugar600ml soda water2 cups crushed iceMuddle the mint, sugar and juice of a lime gently in each of 4 tall glasses.Add the rum and fill with crushed ice.Top with soda, stir up from the bottom and garnish with mint.An ice-cold Diet CokeJust one calorie.
